datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2014, classifying geographic areas by acute food insecurity phase. The spatial data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats with standardized metadata fields including classification scale, scenario, and collection date to represent the current food security situation across Uganda.
